# Piixpal

> 300+ free, open-source (MIT) animated UI components and templates for websites: pixel characters that live on the page, WebGL shader backgrounds, animated hero sections, 74 landing-page hero templates, ASCII animations, buttons, cards, text effects and form controls. Standard web components with zero dependencies: plain HTML, React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, Astro, shadcn.

## Install (pick one)
- Script tag: <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/piixpal@0.4/piixpal.min.js"></script>, then use any tag below anywhere.
- One component only: <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/piixpal@0.4/dist/c/NAME.min.js"></script>
- npm: npm install piixpal. React: import { PiixPal } from "piixpal/react"; <PiixPal pal="bitbug" />. Vue: app.use(Piixpal) from "piixpal/vue".
- shadcn: npx shadcn@latest add https://piixpal.dvkk.dev/r/NAME.json, then import { Name } from "@/components/piixpal/NAME". Index: https://piixpal.dvkk.dev/r/registry.json
- Hero templates: each is one self-contained HTML file at https://piixpal.dvkk.dev/templates/SLUG/ (view source, copy, edit the words).
- No markup: <script src="…/piixpal.min.js" data-pals="bitbug@h1, boing@footer"></script>

## Rules
- Components are browser-only custom elements; in Next.js use them from client components (the React wrappers and shadcn files already are).
- A pal lives on the element it is placed inside (or on="css selector"). It never blocks clicks; box="selector" keeps it inside one element.
- Everything decorative is aria-hidden and honours prefers-reduced-motion. Animated components pause off-screen.
- Licence: MIT. No account, no key, free for commercial use.

## Docs
- [UI components](https://piixpal.dvkk.dev/ui/): 137 animated components (backgrounds, heroes, shaders, buttons, text, forms…)
- [Hero templates](https://piixpal.dvkk.dev/templates/): 74 full landing-page heroes
- [Pixel characters](https://piixpal.dvkk.dev/components/): pals, sprites, superpowers, 3D
- [Install](https://piixpal.dvkk.dev/components/install): every way to add Piixpal
- [FAQ](https://piixpal.dvkk.dev/faq)
- [Full list for agents](https://piixpal.dvkk.dev/llms-full.txt)
- [Source](https://github.com/diiviikk5/Piixpal)

## Characters (121)
- Bitbug: A lime beetle that crawls along the real outline of your letters.
- Boing: A jelly drop that bounces on your footer and lands with a splat.
- Moss: A mushroom that sits on your text reading its book, ignoring you (mostly).
- Lurk: A shy creature that peeks over the edge of your cards.
- Thread: A spider that dangles from your nav on a long thread.
- Pip: A round bird that hops between your buttons and perches on them.
- Bumble: A fuzzy bee that buzzes about your element.
- Shel: A snail that creeps along your text, leaving a shiny trail.
- Gecko: A gecko that climbs up and around the sides of your cards.
- Mole: Whack-a-mole: it pops out of your element, you bop it.
- Balloon: A balloon with a face, tied to your element, bobbing in the breeze.
- Para: A parachutist who drops onto your section when it scrolls into view.
- Roomba: A robot vacuum that sweeps along your footer, very seriously.
- Kitty: A black cat that lounges on your element and swats at the cursor.
- Hiss: A snake that slithers along your headings.
- Pinch: A crab that walks sideways along your text.
- Shibe: A shiba that lounges on your text, tail wagging.
- Capy: A capybara with a yuzu on its head, completely unbothered.
- Peeper: Guards your inputs: follows the caret, covers its eyes for passwords.
- Scrolly: A little runner on a reading-progress bar.
- Echo: A copycat cursor that replays your moves half a second late.
- Snip: A highlighter that hops to whatever text you select.
- Beep: A robot that panics when someone ticks “I’m not a robot”.
- Router: A Wi-Fi router whose signal bars follow your cursor.
- Termi: A tiny terminal that types out your lines, one character at a time.
- Frog: A frog that snaps its tongue at your cursor.
- Penguin: A penguin that belly-slides along your element.
- Rocket: Sits on your Deploy button. Click it: countdown, lift-off, landing.
- Ball: A beach ball you can throw around your page.
- Duck: A rubber duck you can throw. It squeaks when it lands.
- Dice: Throw it and it lands on a random face.
- Pebble: A heavy rock that lands with a thud every pal hears.
- Cube: A jelly cube that bounces high and wobbles.
- Can: A soda can that rolls off the edge of everything.
- Ducks: A mother duck and her ducklings.
- Ants: A marching line of ants, some carrying crumbs.
- Fish: A school of fish that swims inside any box and flees your cursor.
- Sparrows: Birds on a wire that scatter when you get close.
- Choir: A choir who sway and sing in perfect time from a shared score.
- Fireflies: Soft blinking lights drifting around an element.
- Sheep: Sheep trot along and jump the fence one at a time, forever.
- Bees: Worker bees buzzing round their hive.
- Bulb: A pull-chain light switch for dark mode.
- Pix: A tiny hero that lets visitors play your page as a platformer.
- Weather: Snow that settles on your letters, plus rain, leaves and petals.
- Pidge: Toast notifications, delivered by pigeon.
- Plane: A plane that tows your announcement banner across the page.
- Fetch: A dog that runs off on every fetch() and brings back the response.
- Scout: Onboarding tours, guided by a tiny explorer.
- Drone: Flies the product picture into your cart when someone adds to cart.
- Crumb: A mouse that eats your cookie banner when someone accepts or rejects.
- Polly: Reads your page aloud, hopping along each word as it is spoken.
- Gist: An owl that sums up your article in a few key points.
- Tabby: A cat that lives in your browser tab’s icon and naps while you’re away.
- Sprout: A focus-timer plant that pops out into its own always-on-top window.
- Nomad: A little traveller who walks between your browser windows.
- Hatch: Every visitor hatches their own one-of-a-kind pet.
- Avatar: A unique animated pixel avatar for any name.
- Gem: A treasure hunt across your whole site.
- Stickers: A sheet of stickers visitors peel off and stick anywhere on your page.
- Buff: A password-strength meter that lifts heavier as the password gets stronger.
- Meh: A face that rides your rating slider, from furious to delighted.
- Squish: A marshmallow that gets squashed as the text nears its limit.
- Gulp: A pelican that gulps down files dropped on your drop zone.
- Plug: Shows up when the connection drops, plugs back in when it returns.
- Voxel: Any pal as a 3D toy you can spin, in eight looks from glossy to ASCII.
- Card: A holographic trading card for any pal, with the pal standing in 3D.
- Planet: A tiny voxel world with pals walking round it.
- Globe: A pal in a snow globe. Shake it.
- Holo: A pal projected as a flickering hologram.
- Room: A little isometric voxel diorama with a pal living in it.
- Alien: A tiny visitor with three eyes and one antenna. Has questions about your CSS.
- Avocado: Half an avocado, proudly showing off its pit. Ripe for exactly one day.
- Battery: A battery that is always charging and always at one percent. Brave.
- Astronaut: A tiny astronaut floating in place. Eyes glow behind the visor.
- Bolt: A chunky robot whose face is a little screen. Its eyes glow.
- Brain: A very big brain, thinking very hard. Sparks race along its folds.
- Crt: A beige monitor from the old internet. Its face glows on the screen.
- Elephant: A baby elephant with big ears and a trunk that never sits still.
- Flick: A little flame with big feelings. Never, ever stands still.
- Fluff: A sheep made almost entirely of cloud. Trots in place, very proudly.
- Gloop: A slow, happy blob that drips a little. Mostly harmless.
- Gpu: A graphics card whose two fans are its eyes. RGB strip included, obviously.
- Hops: Long ears, short attention span. One ear never quite stays up.
- Inky: A small squid with five wiggly arms and one very big question.
- Keycap: A chunky mechanical keycap. Thocky. Click it for a satisfying press.
- Llama: A fluffy llama with a long neck and a calm, knowing look.
- Mumu: A round little bear who would like a snack, please. Ears wiggle.
- Server: A server rack keeping your site alive. Its drive lights never stop.
- Spud: A lumpy potato with a tiny sprout and a lot of potential.
- Tofu: A block of tofu on two stubby legs, marching on the spot. Firm but fair.
- Unicorn: The startup kind. A golden horn, a rainbow mane, a billion-dollar smile.
- Whale: A friendly whale who surfaces now and then for a little spout.
- Boba: A cup of milk tea with a straw and a lot of pearls. Chewy personality.
- Cactus: A potted cactus who blooms when it is in a good mood. Do not hug.
- Candle: A little candle with a flame that never sits still.
- Cherries: Two cherries on one stem. Inseparable. Four eyes, one opinion.
- Cloud: A little cloud with a light, cheerful drizzle.
- Coffee: A mug of coffee, steaming gently, quietly judging your sleep schedule.
- Cookie: A chocolate chip cookie with one bite missing. It knows who did it.
- Donut: A strawberry donut with sprinkles. Has a hole in its life and is fine with it.
- Dragon: A pocket dragon. Flaps its little wings. Breathes a little fire now and then.
- Egg: An egg with a crack and a lot of questions.
- Floppy: A floppy disk who remembers when 1.44 MB was a lot. Also, the save icon.
- Heart: A like button with feelings. Beats steadily, blushes easily.
- Inbox: An envelope with a notification badge it cannot stop checking.
- Loaf: A ginger cat in its most efficient shape. Ears twitch when you are not looking.
- Mochi: A soft pink rice cake. Squishy, blushy, easily delighted.
- Modem: A dial-up modem. Its lights blink in a pattern only it understands.
- Onigiri: A rice ball in a seaweed jacket. Calm, round-ish, triangular.
- Prompty: A chat bubble who is always just about to reply. Thinking… thinking…
- Pudding: A caramel pudding on a plate. Cannot stop jiggling.
- Robo: A tiny robot head. The antenna light means it is thinking. It is always thinking.
- Star: A little star who twinkles on purpose. Main-character energy.
- Sushi: A piece of salmon nigiri wearing its fish like a very good blanket.
- Toast: A slice of toast with a pat of butter slowly giving up.
- Token: A little gold token that spins. Every model wants it. Context is everything.
- Ufo: A very small visitor. Came in peace, stayed for the cursor.
- Wizard: A very small wizard whose hat does most of the work. Sparkles on request.
- Crowd: Hundreds of tiny agents on one canvas: they wander, swarm your cursor, or spell a word.
- PixelType: Any font as chunky extruded pixel blocks that pals can walk on.
